query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) as max_snap 
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
wealthy_households AS (
    SELECT head_of_household_id 
    FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index 
    WHERE wealth_level = 'Rich'
),
pop_25_40 AS (
    SELECT hp.id
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    WHERE hp.snapshot = ls.max_snap
    AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
    AND hp.age BETWEEN 25 AND 40
),
graduates_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id 
    FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala 
    WHERE qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')
),
non_graduate_wealthy AS (
    SELECT d.id, d.head_of_household_id
    FROM pop_25_40 p
    JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON p.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN graduates_list g ON p.id = g.id
    WHERE g.id IS NULL
    AND d.head_of_household_id IN (SELECT head_of_household_id FROM wealthy_households)
)
SELECT 
    hl.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ng.id) as wealthy_count
FROM non_graduate_wealthy ng
JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON ng.id = hl.id
WHERE hl.city IS NOT NULL 
  AND hl.city != 'nan'
  AND TRIM(hl.city) != ''
GROUP BY hl.city
ORDER BY wealthy_count DESC
LIMIT 5
raw_question: رتب لي اعلى خمس مدن من حيث عدد الأثرياء بين عمر 25 و 40 سنة الذين لا يملكون شهادات جامعية حسب احد...
